PSS_rule: Unchanged47b8 all eligible phases per-run sampled app-tree maximum; range of3 observed run maxima. CPU/disk unknown never filters PSS; no eligible sample is unobserved, never zero.
caption_draft: Instrumented Friendster application wall at 320 and 6,400 measured graphs after 256 warmup graphs. Stacks partition mean launch-to-recorded-wait wall into four disjoint intervals; markers retain all three totals and diamonds show mean ± sample SD. Full consumed-input hashing, resource/affinity/disk observations, metadata fsync and fresh native promotion/fsync on the admitted PVC are included. Common input audits, C++ build and post-exit native verification are outside applications. Prefetch overlaps training and shutdown and is not a separate additive segment. Storage placement can affect timings; no production-throughput, time-to-quality, population crossover or causal ratio to E23/failed attempts is inferred.
earlier_stop_scope: Known hard-guard propagation bug fixed; cause of external replica-zero stop, including disk-full/scaler causation, remains unknown.
exact_accounting: Recover unique integer elapsed ns within0.01ns JSON roundtrip tolerance. Each run integer partition sums exactly; mean intervals use rational ns/3 and exactly sum to mean total. Floating rendering uses strict rounding tolerance; TABLEDATA retains integer endpoints/intervals and rational fractions.

input_contract.extra_gates: Whole independently known audit SHA; exact environment_v4 mask/24 app guards/4 tiny qualification consumers, storage_v4 original admission+raw disk+null controller latch+latest sampled inventory; all 3 process values in all 8 groups; source-only schema refused before Matplotlib import.

prior_capsule.scope: Available local observations/source preservation only; no recovered partial metrics/actual OS exit0. Failed v2/v1 remain nested once; no expansion/pooling.

platform_context.scope: Recorded pre-science PVC/image/CPU/write-test facts only; no current liveness, completed cohort, exclusive cores/bandwidth, disk reservation or continuous/global health claim.

use_gate: Genuine completed raw collection and independent audit, then actual figure visual/layout review before any manuscript/release integration. Root owns methods; no methods copied.

visual_design.panels: W1 and W8; linear common y scale
visual_design.repetition_offsets: Fixed categorical offsets, no interpolation or crossover fit
visual_design.statistics: Mean plus sample SD of 3 fresh processes, not CI/population uncertainty
visual_design.style: Colorblind-friendly stages, DejaVu Sans 8 pt, vector PDF/SVG and 360 dpi PNG after genuine audit only
